name: godot-game-dev-studio
description: Codex plugin assembled by Powehi for Godot 4.7+ game-development skills, examples, patterns, and studio orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Godot 4.7+ gamedev skills with studio orchestration.
interface.longDescription: A broad Codex toolkit for Godot and game-development work, covering architecture, gameplay systems, animation, physics, UI, shaders, networking, optimization, testing, export workflows, genre patterns, publishing workflows, specialized addons, and studio-style orchestration roles. Assembled and curated by Powehi from Divergent AI / GD Agentic Skills, awesome-gamedev-agent-skills, GodotPrompter, Claude-Code-Game-Studios, godot-worldmap-builder, and other open gamedev resources.
